verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents a programmable SMS API, including a 'Sending SMS' guide and SMS/MMS among its API suite. It also has an event notifications and subscriptions system, but the evidence never ties that system to inbound SMS or delivery status. So sending is evidenced, while receiving and delivery callbacks are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of receiving inbound SMS via the API, documented SMS delivery-status callbacks/webhooks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
